column1: requirement_text
AUTOSAR communication shall support the CAN communication bus.
The Can Driver shall support Standard Identifier and Extended Identifier.
The CAN driver shall allow the static configuration of the hard-ware reception filter
The bit timing of each CAN Controller shall be configurable
Hardware Object Handles shall be provided for the CAN Inter-face in the static configuration file
The CAN Driver shall implement an interface for initialization
The CAN Driver shall support dynamic selection of configuration sets
The CAN Driver shall provide a service to enable/disable interrupts of the CAN Controller.
The CAN Driver shall guarantee data consistency of received L-PDUs
The CAN Driver shall offer a reception indication service
The CAN Driver shall implement an interface for deinitialization
CAN Driver shall provide a notification for bus-off state
The CAN driver shall not recover from bus-off automatically
The CAN Interface configuration shall be able to import information from CAN communication matrix
The AUTOSAR CAN Transport Layer shall be statically configurable to support either single or multiple connections in an optimizing way
AUTOSAR communication shall support the standardized transport protocol for Diagnostics over CAN
The CAN Driver shall fulfill the general requirements for Basic Software Modules as specified in AUTOSAR_SRS_SPAL
The CAN Driver shall offer a Hardware independent interface.
The CAN Interface implementation and interface shall be independent from underlying CAN Controller and CAN Transceiver
The CAN State Manager shall offer a network abstract API to upper layer
The CAN Interface and Driver shall offer a CAN Controller specific interface for initialization
The FlexRay Interface shall provide a PDU-based data API to all upper layers
Abstraction of FlexRay CC-specific Implementation shall be provided
The FlexRay Driver shall be able to communicate with at least four FlexRay CCs of the same type
The CC Hardware FIFO Mechanism shall be supported
Hardware Message ID Filter Mechanism according to the FlexRay Protocol Specification 3.0 shall be supported
The transceiver driver package shall include a description file with the basic information needed to configure the driver for a given bus and the supported notifications
Abstraction of FlexRay-Specific Features shall be provided
The FlexRay Interface shall allocate the needed memory space only once for a PDU sent multiple times in the FlexRay matrix
Configuration of the FlexRay Interface shall be done at System Configuration Time
ISO 10681-2 or ISO 15765-2 or both Specifications shall be selected
The FlexRay Transport Layer shall be configured to be compliant with the ISO 10681-2 specification
The FlexRay Transceiver Driver shall handle the transceiver-specific timing requirements internally.
The module will operate as an independent instance in each of the partitions, means the called API will only target the partition it is called in.
The ECUC partitions referenced by CanController EcucPartitionRef shall be a subset of the ECUC partitions referenced by CanEcuc PartitionRef.
CanController and CanTrcvChannel of one communication channel shall all reference the same ECUC partition
If CanEcucPartitionRef references one or more ECUC partitions, CanControllerEcucPartitionRef shall have a multiplicity of one and reference one of these ECUC partitions as well.
